subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should `backup create` support implicit `.backupignore` auto-loading, or should exclude behavior remain explicit through CLI flags/files until maintainers approve a default?
rationale: This PR adds new public CLI behavior and a backup-content policy surface that can change what is captured for restore, so the permanent default cannot be chosen safely by code review alone.

options.title: Require Explicit Excludes
options.body: Keep excludes behind `--exclude`, `--exclude-file`, or an explicitly named opt-in flag and require the PR to implement per-asset filtering plus proof before merge.

options.title: Approve Auto-Loading
options.body: Accept `.backupignore` as a product default only with maintainer-approved docs, security rationale, and upgrade behavior for existing state directories.

options.title: Replace With Narrow PR
options.body: Pause this branch and land a smaller maintainer-led fix for the linked exclude-pattern issue and large-backup reports.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit Excludes
recommendation.body: Keep excludes behind `--exclude`, `--exclude-file`, or an explicitly named opt-in flag and require the PR to implement per-asset filtering plus proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup docs, retry, verify, and state migration history make this the strongest available owner for the CLI/security policy choice.
